# StrictMode violations the device test audit accepts, checked by e2e/android/strictmode_audit.py.
#
# Format: <policy> <violation> <site>   # reason
#   policy     VM or THREAD
#   violation  the StrictMode violation class name
#   site       Class.method of the frame closest to the violation in ly.count.android.sdk (the Android SDK or the
#              bridge), anonymous class numbers dropped, or Class.* for every method of the class
#
# The entries for the Android SDK's own code follow the allowlist of the Android SDK repository.

# Init reads the persisted state synchronously. The first read of a SharedPreferences file waits for it to finish
# loading and is reported, and which method gets there first depends on timing.
THREAD DiskReadViolation CountlyStore.*
THREAD DiskReadViolation ModuleDeviceId.*
THREAD DiskWriteViolation CountlyStore.<init>                 # first use creates the shared_prefs directory

# Native crash dumps left by sdk-native are looked for, sent, and deleted during init.
THREAD DiskReadViolation ModuleCrash.checkForNativeCrashDumps
THREAD DiskWriteViolation ModuleCrash.checkForNativeCrashDumps
